title: 米中間選挙情勢、下院は民主優勢　トランプ氏支持低迷で優位失う共和　上院の接戦州に注目
extracted_text: 【ワシントン＝塩原永久】米国の二大政党である共和党と民主党は中間選挙に向け、各州で自党の候補を決める予備選を実施する。一部の州で3月から始まっており、9月まで続く。共和党のトランプ大統領の支持率が低迷し、選挙情勢分析の専門家は、現時点で下院は野党・民主党がリードし、上院でも与党・共和党が優位を失いつつあるとの見方を示している。 全435議席を改選する下院に関し、米エマーソン大学が4月下旬に実施した世論調査で、投票先を共和党と答えた有権者が40％だったのに対し、民主党との回答は50％だった。残り10％は未定とした。 民主党は共和党に10ポイント先行し、前月調査より差を3ポイント広げた。昨年末まで僅差だったが、今年に入り差が広がっている。 下院の現有勢力は共和218、民主212、欠員5。バージニア大学のサバト教授らによるグループの中間選の情勢分析（4月21日）では、共和党の獲得が確実か優勢な議席数が205、民主党は217と見込んだ。残り13が接戦としている。他の有力な選挙情勢分析も、現時点では民主党の優勢を見込んでいる。 一方、上院の改選議席は、共和党地盤の選挙区が多く、同党が多数派を維持するとみられてきたが、接戦にもつれ込むとの見方が出てきた。 現有勢力は共和53、民主47。過半数を目指す民主党は、改選35のうち現有の13議席をすべて守った上で、共和党が持つ4議席を奪う必要がある。ハードルは高いとみられていたが、共和党がリードを失いつつある接戦州をとれば、多数派奪取の可能性もある。
translated_text: [Washington = Naohisa Shiobara] The two major US parties, Republicans and Democrats, are holding primaries in various states to select their candidates for the midterm elections. Some states began in March and will continue through September. With Republican President Trump's approval ratings lagging, election analysis experts say Democrats currently lead in the House, and Republicans are losing their advantage in the Senate as well. Regarding the House, where all 435 seats are up for election, a poll conducted by Emerson College in late April found that 40% of voters said they would vote Republican, while 50% said Democrat. The remaining 10% were undecided. Democrats led Republicans by 10 points, widening the gap by 3 points from the previous month's survey. The race was razor-thin until the end of last year, but the gap has widened since the start of this year. The current House composition is Republicans 218, Democrats 212, with 5 vacancies. An analysis group led by Professor Sabato at the University of Virginia (April 21) projected Republicans to win 205 seats that are certain or likely to flip, compared to 217 for Democrats, with 13 seats considered too close to call. Other major election analyses also see Democrats with an advantage at this time. For the Senate, while many of the seats up for election are in Republican-leaning districts and the party was expected to maintain the majority, there are now indications that some races could turn into close contests. The current composition is Republicans 53, Democrats 47. To achieve a majority, Democrats need to defend all 13 of their seats up for election and capture 4 Republican-held seats. While this was considered a high bar, the party could seize the majority if it wins some of the tight Senate races where Republicans are losing their lead.
title_en: US Midterm Election Outlook: Democrats Lead in House as Republicans Lose Advantage Amid Low Trump Support; Tight Senate Races in Focus
